hierarchy.L2: status, progress, workspace and runtime objects
hierarchy.L3: analytics, activity, history, reviews and audit summaries

surfaces.canvas: cool neutral with a faint palette-tinted ambient wash
surfaces.surface: translucent white in light theme and cool charcoal glass in dark theme
surfaces.inset: lighter translucent inset surface with a quiet hairline boundary
surfaces.border: 1px translucent neutral line paired with backdrop blur
surfaces.shadow: soft layered highlight and depth on glass surfaces; stronger shadow only for overlays
surfaces.decorativeGradient: restrained ambient light only; no rings or animated orbs

components.disclosure: Use native details/summary for advanced or low-frequency settings.

responsive.desktop: stable sidebar and content width; multi-column only when it improves scanning
responsive.narrow: single-column task order, secondary controls collapse, no page-level horizontal scrolling

blockingFailures: primary state conveyed by color only
analytics visually outranking current tasks or risks
misleading success status when no records exist
low-frequency technical settings dominating the initial view
